name: Acme Wire Products Co., Inc.
old_description: Acme Wire Products specializes in precision fabrication of components, parts, and products. While much of our work focuses on industrial applications – everything and anything from stainless steel baskets and machine guards to medical carts and frames – we also produce consumer goods from sporting goods components to custom sink accessories.
about:
Acme Wire Products Co., Inc. was founded in 2000 in Mystic, Connecticut. The company began as a precision wire fabrication shop serving industrial and commercial markets.

Today the company specializes in CNC wire forming up to 1/2-inch diameter, 2D and 3D CNC wire bending, wire straightening and cutting, welding, CNC stamping and forming, electrostatic powder coating, and fluid bed coating. Materials processed include carbon steel, stainless steel, titanium, Inconel, and Monel in wire diameters from 0.060 to 0.50 inch. Standard diameters are stocked for faster turnaround, while custom sizes and alloys can be sourced as needed. The shop produces wire guard cages, industrial cleaning baskets, wire baskets, wireforms, frames, racks, filter support weldments, battery straps, wire bails, wire grids, fan guards, and complete custom wire fabrications.

Acme Wire serves medical and food processing, industrial and OEM, safety and HVAC, telecommunications and premise wiring, sporting goods, and material handling sectors. Examples include stainless steel baskets and medical carts for healthcare, cable management trays and routing rings for telecom infrastructure, wire facemasks meeting NOCSAE standards for sporting equipment, and custom wire baskets and trays for protecting parts during material handling.

The company emphasizes turnkey capabilities, expert craftsmanship, and ISO 9001 certification as key differentiators. It maintains stock of standard wire diameters to expedite manufacturing and offers customized wire sizes and materials to suit specific applications.
